sentences.en: health threatening situation and that's when doctors can intervene.
sentences.zh: 威胁健康的情况，那时医生才能介入。

sentences.en: And, you know, it can often take a long time to get to that point.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，通常需要很长时间才能达到那个地步。

sentences.en: So you have a situation where doctors are unable to treat the pregnant person because they're waiting for her to get sicker and sicker and sicker.
sentences.zh: 所以就会出现这种情况：医生无法治疗孕妇，因为他们必须等着她病得越来越重。

sentences.en: And there was actually a study just published recently with two major hospitals in Texas and they looked at the experience of patients in this circumstance after
sentences.zh: 事实上，最近刚发表了一项研究，涉及德克萨斯州的两家大型医院，他们观察了在

sentences.en: Texas passed its law that we were talking about and they found that patients had to wait an average of nine days until either the heartbeat stopped or they got so sick that
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯州通过我们刚才讨论的那项法律后，处于这种境况下的患者的经历，结果发现患者平均需要等待九天，直到心跳停止或者她们病得非常严重，以至于

sentences.en: doctors could legally intervene under the law and that more than half of those women ended up with serious infections or serious hemorrhaging.
sentences.zh: 医生在法律上可以进行干预，而那些女性中有一半以上最终出现了严重的感染或大出血。

sentences.en: basically their health got a lot worse before doctors were able to do anything about it and there was no way that they were going to have a viable pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 基本上，在医生能够采取任何措施之前，她们的健康状况已经恶化了很多，而且她们根本不可能维持健康的妊娠。

sentences.en: So before these laws, doctors would have intervened much earlier in one way or another, but now that these laws are in place, they don't intervene because they
sentences.zh: 所以在这些法律出台之前，医生无论如何都会更早地进行干预，但现在这些法律生效了，他们不干预是因为他们

sentences.en: can't intervene, which in a very real way puts the mother in danger even though the pregnancy is not viable.
sentences.zh: 无法干预，这在现实中确实让孕妇处于危险之中，即使妊娠本身已经无法维持。

sentences.en: Yes, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: And it's not as if the supporters of these abortion bans didn't anticipate this kind of scenario.
sentences.zh: 而且这并不是说这些堕胎禁令的支持者没有预料到这种情况。

sentences.en: It's actually kind of baked right into these laws and that's because they have an ethical framework where they are equating the fetus with the pregnant person.
sentences.zh: 这实际上已经融入了这些法律之中，因为他们有一种道德框架，将胎儿与孕妇等同起来。

sentences.en: And so in their view, if there is still fetal cardiac activity, then they are saying that that is the equivalent to the life of the pregnant woman.
sentences.zh: 在他们看来，如果胎儿还有心跳，那么他们就认为这等同于孕妇的生命。

sentences.en: And so the doctor can't do anything to extinguish that fetal cardiac activity, even if it means that the pregnant woman's health is going to get worse and worse while they're
sentences.zh: 因此，医生不能做任何事情来终止胎儿的心跳，即使这意味着孕妇的健康状况会在他们

sentences.en: waiting.
sentences.zh: 等待的过程中变得越来越糟。

sentences.en: Pam, I wonder where this leaves what is really supposed to be a kind of sacred relationship in medicine between patient and doctor, between those those who are pregnant and
sentences.zh: 帕姆，我想知道这让医学中本应神圣的医患关系处于什么境地，也就是孕妇与

sentences.en: the doctors that they expect to be advocates for their health.
sentences.zh: 她们期望成为其健康倡导者的医生之间的关系。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So I think, you know, in an ideal world, patients would go to the doctor and they would get the best treatment for their condition.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，你知道，在理想的世界里，患者去看医生，他们会得到针对其病情的最佳治疗。

sentences.en: You know, you break your leg and you don't expect the doctor to be grilling you about whether you were jaywalking when you fell and your leg got broken.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你摔断了腿，你不会指望医生盘问你摔倒导致腿骨折时是否在乱穿马路。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So this situation sets up a climate where the distrust can get so great that you may have patients who are reluctant to go to the doctor because they're worried that they're going
sentences.zh: 所以这种情况造成了一种不信任感极强的氛围，你可能会遇到不愿去看医生的患者，因为她们担心自己会

sentences.en: to be questioned and you may have doctors who are reluctant to follow their best medical instincts because they're worried that somebody's going to think that they're providing an
sentences.zh: 受到盘问；你可能还会遇到不愿遵循最佳医疗直觉的医生，因为他们担心有人会认为他们在进行

sentences.en: abortion when they're not.

sentences.en: And that's the kind of scenario that hits hardest for people in communities where there has already been distrust of medical institutions and there's already been systemic

sentences.en: problems that have led to lack of access.
sentences.zh: 导致医疗资源匮乏的系统性问题。

sentences.en: So I think there's a real concern that for some people, health care in pregnancy and maybe health care in general is going to get worse.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为人们确实担心，对一些人来说，孕期医疗保健，甚至可能是整体的医疗保健，将会变得更糟。
